newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico to announce Chihuahua natgas permit winner.
newsitem.headline: Mexico to announce Chihuahua natgas permit winner.

text.p: Mexico's Energy Regulatory Commission will announce Wednesday the winner of auction for the first private permit to distribute natural gas, the Energy Ministry said Tuesday.
The permit will give the winner rights to distribute natural gas in a zone around the northern industrial city of Chihuahua.

Mexico is auctioning off rights for the distribution of natural gas in main metropolitan areas in a move to promote the use of less polluting fuel and substitute current thin pipelines with more secure transport means.
